multi_entity_note: Aduro Biotech, Inc. and IREYA B.V. (represented by Andrea van Elsas), with two addresses.
processing_note: On a monthly basis, Consultant shall submit to Aduro an invoice for the hours worked along with itemized documentation and receipts and other information for pre-approved travel and/or out-of- pocket expenses as Aduro reasonably requests at the time reimbursement is requested.

contract.document_name.rationale: The title and preamble both name the contract Consulting Agreement.

contract.agreement_date.rationale: The agreement is 'dated June 1, 2020'; July 1 is the effective date and December 31 the end of term.

contract.expiration_date.rationale: Section 3: the term continues until December 31, 2020 unless extended or terminated.

contract.governing_law.rationale: Section 10 applies the laws of the State of California; the Netherlands is an address and the last California is the conflict-of-law reference.

contract.renewal_term.rationale: No renewal term; the agreement may only be extended by mutual written agreement.

contract.notice_period.rationale: No renewal and no notice period to prevent renewal; the options are a payment period and a non-solicit period.
